title: The Circuit-Canopy Where Branches Broadcast

features.name: broadcast node
features.desc-on-touch: A branch that learns to think in circuits, sending what it knows to every neighbor in the grove.

features.name: signal-leaf
features.desc-on-touch: A leaf that reads the logic of the branches and speaks it back to the air. The forest is a parliament now.

features.name: learning-canopy
features.desc-on-touch: The interwoven branches are reading each other. Each learns what the others know. The grove is thinking as one body now.

features.name: root-chorus
features.desc-on-touch: Underground, the roots are humming in unison. They are the network's first language, older than branches.

inscription: the forest taught itself to broadcast, and now it learns by growing into conversation
